reviewNotes: Unreviewed AI translation drafts for Arabic (ar), Urdu (ur), and Persian (fa) field seed UI copy. Intended drafting boundaries: (1) Absence of a nursery phase describes operational cycle planning without implying biological impossibility, construction failure, or proof of botanical direct sowing; (2) Whole-seed requirements and counts in rows 02 and 08 express integer seed numbers and gross totals, avoiding physical seed integrity or dehusked quality claims; (3) Explicit material declaration is maintained; (4) Exact ASCII literals DEMO and CSV are preserved verbatim without directional control characters, HTML tags, or invisible isolators; (5) Blank remains unknown while confirmed zero is an explicit planning entry. Specific corrections applied: ar03 preserves the temporal nursery-review horizon; ar05 uses explicit declaration-not-provided wording (لم يُقدَّم إقرار) avoiding permission or authorization ambiguity; ur07 expresses general material for asexual propagation from plant parts without selecting cutting subtypes or seeds; ur08 states explicit seed quantity rates without tariff or price implications; ur12 and fa12 preserve whitespace characters, with fa12 using standard کاراکترهای فضای سفید. Text-only RTL translations do not establish UI RTL readiness; named human review and real bidirectional layout testing are required. No runtime language activation or semantic certification is claimed.
